overview_description.description:
CSPA (Computer Science Proficiency Assessment) is a comprehensive standardized exam for software engineers that assesses their technical knowledge, skills, and abilities across a broad array of topics.

The CSPA is a one day, five hour test which can be taken at home or at a testing center. Anyone can take the exam, with no age requirement or credential requirement.
